title: Build JARVIS failure-context analyzer module
deliverable: A module in agents/jarvis/ that reads HEARTBEAT.md failure entries and enriches them with CONTEXT.md business-layer data before re-prompting.
acceptance: Given a simulated failed step in HEARTBEAT.md, the module produces a re-prompt payload that includes the original error, the relevant CONTEXT.md constraint, and the department-level goal; verified by unit assertions on the enriched payload structure.

title: Implement context-aware re-prompting in agent-loop cycle
deliverable: Updated agent-loop.yaml execute_step and write_result sections wired to call the failure-context analyzer and inject enriched context into the next cycle's prompt.
acceptance: An agent that fails step N on cycle C produces a re-prompt on cycle C+1 whose prompt string contains the failure reason and the matched CONTEXT.md rule; asserted via loop integration test.

title: Add Ralph Loop V2 retry ledger to TASKS.md schema
deliverable: Extended task.md template with retry_ledger field (array of {cycle, error, re_prompt_strategy, outcome}) and updated loop-runner.sh to write ledger entries on each retry.
acceptance: After three failed retries on a synthetic blocked step, TASKS.md contains a retry_ledger array with three entries each bearing a non-empty re_prompt_strategy value.

title: Implement JARVIS escalation with unblock recommendation
deliverable: JARVIS escalation handler that, upon receiving a blocked step alert, synthesizes an unblock recommendation message written to the reporting agent's INBOX.md instead of a bare escalation notice.
acceptance: Triggering a 3-consecutive-blocked-cycles condition causes JARVIS to append an INBOX.md entry to the blocked agent containing at minimum one actionable suggested step; verified by reading the target INBOX.md post-run.

title: Build prompt-pattern logger for successful step completions
deliverable: A logger that writes structured prompt-pattern records to vault/development/prompt-patterns.jsonl whenever a step completes successfully, capturing agent ID, task type, prompt structure hash, and outcome.
acceptance: Running five distinct successful agent steps produces five appended records in prompt-patterns.jsonl, each containing agent_id, task_type, and prompt_hash fields with non-null values.

title: Add reward signal hooks for CI pass and PR merge events
deliverable: GitHub Actions workflow step and loop-runner hook that emit reward signal events (ci_passed, pr_merged, review_approved) to vault/development/reward-signals.jsonl with timestamp and linked step ID.
acceptance: A successful CI run against a test PR appends a ci_passed record to reward-signals.jsonl within 60 seconds of job completion; verified by tail of the file post-run.

title: Wire reward signals into weekly evolve-cycle template
deliverable: Updated templates/evolve-cycle.md that includes a reward_signal_summary section auto-populated from reward-signals.jsonl, surfacing top-performing prompt patterns in the weekly evolution questions.
acceptance: The weekly evolution script reads reward-signals.jsonl and populates at least one reward_signal_summary entry in the evolve-cycle output document; verified by diff of a generated evolve-cycle.md against the blank template.

title: Implement model router with per-task-type dispatch table
deliverable: A model-router module (scripts/model-router.sh or Node module) that reads task tags and agent role from MANIFEST.yaml and returns the appropriate model endpoint: Codex for backend/logic, Claude Code for frontend/git, Gemini for design/UI.
acceptance: Given tags=[code,backend], router returns openai/gpt-5.3-codex; given tags=[design,ui], router returns google-gemini-cli/gemini-2.5-flash; given tags=[frontend,git], router returns claude-code; all three assertions pass in a model-router unit test.

title: Integrate model router into loop-runner agent invocation
deliverable: Updated invoke_agent() in scripts/loop-runner.sh that calls the model router before spawning an agent cycle and passes the resolved model endpoint as a --model flag to the openclaw run command.
acceptance: Loop runner logs show the model endpoint appended to each invoke line; a design-tagged agent's log line contains gemini and a code-tagged agent's log line contains codex; verified by grepping loop-runner.log.

title: Build morning Sentry scan task-discovery agent trigger
deliverable: A scheduled trigger (cron 09:00 daily) in workflows/qa-monitoring.yaml that invokes SENTINEL to scan GitHub issues tagged sentry/error, spawn fix-agent tasks for each open error, and write them to CLAWD's INBOX.md.
acceptance: With two synthetic open Sentry-tagged GitHub issues present, the morning scan produces two INBOX.md entries in agents/clawd/INBOX.md within the first cron cycle after 09:00; verified by entry count post-trigger.

title: Add post-meeting feature-request task injection workflow
deliverable: A workflow trigger (event: meeting_notes_created) that invokes CLIP to parse meeting notes from vault/product/meeting-notes.md, extract feature requests, and append them as structured INBOX.md entries to JARVIS's inbox for triage.
acceptance: Placing a meeting-notes.md file with three feature bullet points in vault/product/ triggers CLIP to produce three INBOX.md entries in agents/jarvis/INBOX.md with tag=feature and source=meeting_notes; verified by entry count and tag values.

title: Implement evening changelog and docs generation trigger
deliverable: A cron trigger (18:00 daily) that invokes SCRIBE to read reward-signals.jsonl and completed TASKS.md entries from the day, generate a CHANGELOG-YYYY-MM-DD.md entry in vault/content/, and update docs with any new patterns from prompt-patterns.jsonl.
acceptance: Running the evening trigger with five simulated completed tasks produces a non-empty CHANGELOG file in vault/content/ whose entries reference at least three of the five completed task IDs; verified by file existence and grep.

title: Build proactive task-discovery orchestration in JARVIS morning cycle
deliverable: JARVIS TASKS.md morning-cycle step that aggregates inbox entries from the Sentry scan, meeting notes, and any overnight vault handoffs, deduplicates, prioritizes, and delegates each item to the correct department INBOX.md within a single 5-minute cycle.
acceptance: With 6 inbox entries across Sentry and meeting-notes sources, JARVIS's morning cycle produces exactly 6 delegated INBOX.md entries distributed across department agents with no duplicates; verified by summing INBOX.md entry counts across all 11 agents.

title: Extend manifest.yaml with model routing and proactive discovery config
deliverable: Updated manifest.yaml with a model_routing section (per-tag model assignments) and a proactive_discovery section (enabled flags, cron times, and source definitions for morning scan, post-meeting, and evening changelog).
acceptance: Running the bootstrap sequence against the updated manifest.yaml completes without validation errors and the model_routing and proactive_discovery keys are present and structurally valid per a YAML schema lint check.

title: Write unit tests for loop-runner.sh core functions
deliverable: Bash unit test file (tests/unit/test-loop-runner.bats) covering discover_agents, is_within_working_hours, invoke_agent guard logic, and tier interval assignment using the bats-core framework.
acceptance: Running bats tests/unit/test-loop-runner.bats exits 0 with all tests passing and covers at least 8 distinct test cases across the four targeted functions.

title: Write unit tests for worktree manager and task registry
deliverable: Unit test suite (tests/unit/test-worktree.bats and tests/unit/test-task-registry.bats) testing worktree creation, checkout, and cleanup; and task registry add, update-status, and dependency-check operations.
acceptance: Both test files execute via bats with zero failures; worktree tests cover at least create, list, and cleanup paths; task registry tests cover add, status-transition, and depends_on guard.

title: Write unit tests for memory flush and search tool
deliverable: Unit test suite (tests/unit/test-memory.bats) covering memory write, flush-to-sqlite, and keyword search operations with fixture MEMORY.md files.
acceptance: All tests pass via bats; tests assert that a written memory entry is retrievable via search within the same test run and that flush produces a SQLite database file with at least one row.

title: Write unit tests for inbox routing and monitoring CRON logic
deliverable: Unit test suite (tests/unit/test-inbox-routing.bats) testing inbox entry parsing, pending-to-processed transitions, overflow escalation at 10-entry threshold, and monitoring CRON interval math.
acceptance: All tests pass via bats; a synthetic 10-entry INBOX.md fixture triggers the escalation path in the parser; CRON interval math tests assert correct elapsed-time calculations for all three tiers.

title: Write integration test for agent spawn-to-PR flow
deliverable: Integration test script (tests/integration/test-spawn-pr-flow.sh) that boots a sandboxed CLAWD+SENTINEL pair with fixture TASKS.md, runs the loop once, and asserts that CLAWD creates a PR stub and SENTINEL writes a review record to vault/development/.
acceptance: The integration test script exits 0 when run against a fresh fixture workspace; vault/development/ contains a review record and a pr-stub file within 30 seconds of test invocation.

title: Write integration test for memory write-flush-search round-trip
deliverable: Integration test (tests/integration/test-memory-roundtrip.sh) that writes three distinct memory entries via the memory module, triggers flush, then asserts each entry is retrievable by keyword search from the SQLite index.
acceptance: Test exits 0; all three entries are returned by their respective keyword queries; the SQLite file created during flush contains at least three rows; test completes within 60 seconds.

title: Write integration test for cross-department vault handoff
deliverable: Integration test (tests/integration/test-vault-handoff.sh) that simulates ATLAS writing a research deliverable to vault/research/, SCRIBE reading it via vault/handoffs/, and SCRIBE producing a content draft in vault/content/.
acceptance: Test exits 0; vault/content/ contains a draft file whose content includes a string extracted from the original ATLAS research fixture; handoff completes within two simulated loop cycles.

title: Write E2E test for full content pipeline workflow
deliverable: End-to-end test (tests/e2e/test-content-pipeline.sh) that triggers the content-pipeline workflow with a synthetic research brief, runs all agent cycles through ATLAS, SCRIBE, and PIXEL handoffs, and asserts final published content lands in vault/content/published/.
acceptance: Test exits 0; vault/content/published/ contains a non-empty output file within 10 simulated cycles; each intermediate handoff artifact (research-brief, content-draft, design-brief) is present in its respective vault directory.

title: Write E2E test for full QA monitoring loop
deliverable: End-to-end test (tests/e2e/test-qa-monitoring-loop.sh) that injects a synthetic bug report into SENTINEL's INBOX.md, runs the qa-monitoring workflow through triage, CLAWD fix, and SENTINEL verification steps, and asserts a verification-report.md lands in vault/development/.
acceptance: Test exits 0; vault/development/verification-report.md exists and contains the synthetic bug ID; the TASKS.md step for fix_implementation has status=done; full loop completes within 15 simulated cycles.

title: Implement credential management and API key rotation system
deliverable: A scripts/rotate-keys.sh script and updated .env.example that supports per-agent API key slots (OPENAI_API_KEY_JARVIS, etc.), key expiry tracking in vault/handoffs/key-registry.yaml, and an automated rotation reminder written to JARVIS's INBOX.md when keys approach 90-day age.
acceptance: Running rotate-keys.sh check with a synthetic key-registry.yaml containing one key dated 91 days ago produces a JARVIS INBOX.md entry with subject=api_key_rotation_required; verified by grep on the INBOX.md after script execution.

title: Implement vault access control and department isolation
deliverable: A vault-access.yaml policy file and enforcement check in loop-runner.sh that prevents an agent from writing to a vault directory outside its own department without an explicit handoff token in vault/handoffs/.
acceptance: Attempting to invoke an agent from the research department to write directly to vault/content/ (without a handoff token) causes loop-runner.sh to log an access_denied entry and skip the write; verified by log grep and absence of the file in vault/content/.

title: Build Docker Compose stack for PostgreSQL + pgvector + n8n + dashboard
deliverable: A docker-compose.yml at repo root defining services for PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension, n8n workflow automation, and the Next.js dashboard; with health checks, named volumes, and a .env-driven configuration layer.
acceptance: Running docker compose up -d exits 0; docker compose ps shows all four services as healthy; the dashboard is reachable at localhost:3000 and n8n is reachable at localhost:5678 within 60 seconds of startup.

title: Create production readiness checklist and pre-flight validation script
deliverable: A scripts/preflight-check.sh script and docs/production-checklist.md that validate: all required env vars set, Docker services healthy, API keys non-empty, vault directory permissions correct, loop-runner accessible, and at least one workflow parseable.
acceptance: Running preflight-check.sh against a fully configured environment exits 0 and prints READY; running it with OPENAI_API_KEY unset exits 1 and prints a line containing FAIL: OPENAI_API_KEY; both outcomes verified in CI.

title: Wire all test suites into GitHub Actions CI pipeline
deliverable: A .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs bats unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests in sequence on every push and pull request, with the preflight-check.sh gating the E2E stage and test results published as GitHub Actions summary annotations.
acceptance: Opening a test pull request triggers the CI workflow; the Actions tab shows unit, integration, and E2E jobs completing in order; a deliberate failure in test-loop-runner.bats causes the unit job to fail and blocks the integration job from starting.
